text.en:
Paragraph (v) of section fourteen hundred and sixty-five of the Revised Administrative Code is
hereby amended so as to read as follows:
"(v) 'Lending investor' includes all persons who make a practice of lending money for themselves or others at

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, December 2, 1932.
